gloss: to focus efforts on; to devote energy to
notes:
A somewhat formal word commonly used in business and organizational contexts to describe strategically directing effort and resources toward a priority area. Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the target of effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注力|ちゅうりょく}する: to focus efforts on ~
- ⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注力|ちゅうりょく}: focus efforts on development
- {注力|ちゅうりょく}⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧: area of focus
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{注力|ちゅうりょく}する: to direct business resources

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}する→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧: to concentrate — broader; can refer to mental focus or physical convergence
- ⟦{専念|せんねん}する→専念する：25369_sennensuru⟧: to devote oneself — implies giving up other things to focus exclusively on one
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put effort into — more colloquial and versatile
- ⟦{傾注|けいちゅう}する→傾注する：19727_keichuusuru⟧: to devote, to pour into — more literary; emphasizes pouring one's whole effort

REGISTER:
Formal. Very common in business reports, press releases, and corporate strategy discussions. In casual conversation, ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ or ⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧ are more natural.

definitions.gloss: to focus efforts on; to devote energy to
definitions.explanation: to direct one's effort, energy, or resources toward a specific goal or task; to prioritize and concentrate efforts on something

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|しん}{商品|しょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注力|ちゅうりょく}する。
examples.english: To focus efforts on developing new products.
